# GrayNest

> GrayNest builds AI voice and chat agents and custom software for
> businesses and startups in Palestine. The agents speak Palestinian
> Arabic and English. Not related to Gray Nest, the vintage market in
> Illinois (graynest.com).

## AI agents
- Answer phone calls, WhatsApp, Instagram and Facebook messages, and website chat
- Book, reschedule and confirm appointments; qualify leads and book meetings
- Hand the conversation to a person on your team when one is needed
- Built for e-commerce and retail, clinics and practices, hotels,
  restaurants and venues, customer support, and inbound sales

## Software engineering
- Web products, iOS and Android apps, backend systems and APIs, internal tools
- Five phases: discovery, architecture, build, ship, maintain
- MVPs for startups in weeks

## Track record
- The GrayNest team has shipped software for Nokia, Red Hat, Stella Stays,
  and more than 20 startups, new and established
